seed_ledger.name: Abilene DC 1, LLC (Goodnight gas pipeline)
seed_ledger.reason: NEW_ROW: Railroad Commission report 25-NC-314 gives operator Abilene DC 1, LLC, Goodnight Gas Pipeline, Armstrong County, 1.5 miles (2.4 km), 20 inch, new system, start 2026-03-01. Abilene DC 1, LLC is the owner of record of the Crusoe and Oracle Abilene campus, so it is a Crusoe data center entity; the Armstrong County Goodnight campus is Crusoe's, filed under another entity (GN DC1, LLC). The Railroad Commission operator list shows Abilene DC 1, LLC also runs a separate Abilene DC 1 Pipeline of about 0.81 miles (likely the Abilene campus lateral, not staged here). No source states that the Goodnight line feeds the Goodnight campus, so the tie is inferred and should be reviewed. Not matched to P8318 (that is Energy Transfer's Abilene laterals). Prior runs left the Goodnight plant seed as NOT_FOUND for gas supply. Searches run: 8. Sources checked: Railroad Commission December 2025 construction report (the line); Railroad Commission September 2026 operator list (operator runs a Goodnight Gas Pipeline); Cleanview Goodnight report (933 MW off-grid plant); Measured AI newsletter (firm pipeline capacity from December 2026); Texas AI Docket (Abilene DC 1, LLC owns the Abilene campus); Compute Atlas Goodnight page (campus entity is GN DC1, LLC).
